findings.narrativeExcerpt: The story explains how the standard $250,000 deposit insurance amount is defined: it applies per account.
findings.evidenceExcerpt: The standard deposit insurance amount is $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, per ownership category.
findings.problem: “per account” materially changes the unit that determines the standard coverage amount.
findings.requiredCorrection: Replace the per-account unit with the source’s unit: per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, per ownership category.
